chunks: Ya'qub ibn Yazid, from al-Ghifari, from Ibrahim ibn 'Ali, from Ja'far, from his father, peace be upon them both.

That the grave of the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his family, was raised one handspan above the ground, and that the Prophet, peace be upon him and his family, ordered that graves be sprinkled with water.

key_terms.رَسُولِ اللَّهِ: the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم
key_terms.رُفِعَ: was raised; indicating elevation above ground level
key_terms.شِبْرًا: a handspan; the reported measure of the grave’s height
key_terms.قَبْرَ: grave; here, specifically the burial place of the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله

ai.seo_question: How high was the grave of the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله, and did the Prophet order sprinkling water on graves?
ai.summary: This hadith reports that the grave of the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله was raised a handspan above the ground. It also states that the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله ordered that graves be sprinkled with water, indicating a known funerary practice in the Prophetic sunnah.
